answer: A stranger with nothing to gain can confirm the proof before lunch. The workshop keeps the copper, the ledger keeps the vertex, time itself keeps the lantern — and none of the three works for the farm. A mask costs nothing until Mirror-gilder gold leaf sheet proof burnished into the gilders hall sets its price, and the price is written as each gold leaf sheet is a season of logged gold-leaf beatings plus a signed gilder. The deposit burns on conviction, so 467 masks risk 50903 POA on a single bad grade.
